description: Implementation of QuicEndpointBase class and QuicEndpointMultiplexer for QUIC protocol simulation, including packet handling, address generation, and trace recording.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase
classes.description: Represents a QUIC endpoint in simulation, handling packet transmission, reception, and tracing.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer
classes.description: Handles writing packets from the endpoint, managing write blocking and packet size.

classes.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer
classes.description: Manages multiple QuicEndpointBase instances, routing packets to the correct endpoint.

methods.name: HashNameIntoFive32BitIntegers
methods.description: Hashes a string name into five 32-bit integers using SHA-1.

methods.name: GetAddressFromName
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random IP address and port based on a name hash.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with simulator, name, and peer name.

methods.name: DropNextIncomingPacket
methods.description: Flags the endpoint to drop the next incoming packet.

methods.name: RecordTrace
methods.description: Sets up trace recording for the endpoint.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming packet if addressed to this endpoint.

methods.name: SetTxPort
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for the endpoint.

methods.name: OnPacketDequeued
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is dequeued from the transmission queue.
